title: AI Engineering Intern
description:
At Light, we’re redefining how software is built, how it’s delivered, and how it works.

We’re building organic software. Software that heals itself. Software that adapts to the user and the business. Software that learns and gets better as it’s used.

Our starting point is finance. Companies including Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. We’re building towards a platform that understands how each business operates and evolves with it.

As an AI Engineering Intern, you’ll help make that happen: building systems that identify mistakes, improve their own behaviour, and prove those improvements work. You’ll work on the agents, models, and infrastructure that turn organic software into something customers can rely on.

Who this is for

You must meet both of these requirements:

  • Currently studying at University of Oxford, or University of Cambridge.

  • A silver medal or higher at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) or International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), or an equivalent level of achievement in another highly competitive endeavour.

If you’re applying with an equivalent achievement, explain the competition or field, your result, and the standard required to achieve it. If you’re at Oxford/Cambridge and you don’t have an equivalent level of achievement we encourage you to not apply.

Our bar for internships at Light is high. You will need the curiosity to explore unfamiliar areas, the willingness to go the extra mile to get things right, the discipline to test your assumptions, and the persistence to keep going when your first approach does not work.

What you’ll work on

You’ll have access to our repositories, real engineering problems, and an internal coding agent that already opens pull requests against production code. Your work will help make these systems more capable and reliable.

  • Help agents learn from their work. Our agent reviews merged pull requests and corrections to update its repository-specific instructions. You’ll shape that process, catch misleading lessons, and test whether new instructions improve its performance.

  • Train and deploy LLM and ML models. Fine-tune SoA LLM models. Run experiments, compare results against the existing pipeline, and establish whether a model is ready for production. Leverage ML tools to enhance the ability of our Agents via e.g. K-means, t-sne, PCA, random forest trees etc. etc.

  • Build Agents. Take full end to end ownership of an agent. Agent do pre-emptive support for the self-healing pipeline; they fix; they communicate with customers; etc.

  • Build evaluations and review tools. Define what a correct answer looks like, create tests that expose failures, and help catch poor output before it reaches customers.

  • Own projects through delivery. Scope the problem, build the solution, debug regressions, and follow through until the customer can rely on what you’ve shipped.

You’ll work alongside exceptional colleagues.

What else we’re looking for

  • Strong programming ability.

  • Something you’ve built beyond coursework or tutorials: a model, agent, tool, or application that does useful work.

  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling, such as LLM APIs, agent frameworks, model fine-tuning, or automated workflows.

  • A habit of investigating why a system failed and testing whether your fix addresses the cause.

  • Clear thinking and the ability to explain your decisions, including what you tried and why it didn’t work.

Open-source contributions, deployed models, and experience building evaluation pipelines are a plus.

How we’ll measure success

Your work should produce measurable improvements: more correct agent-generated changes, better model accuracy, fewer failures reaching users, or tools the team continues to use. You’ll help define those measures and use them to assess what you build.

What you’ll get

  • Internship compensation above the standard market rate.

  • A role based in our London office, working alongside the product and engineering team.

  • Ownership from your first day, with a path to shipping work into production.

How to apply

Send your CV.

Include a link to something you’ve shipped. Tell us what it does, which parts you built yourself, where it failed, and how you fixed it. Then explain why you want to work on organic software at Light.

We want to understand how you think, what you can build, and what you’re ready to take on next.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. title: Applied AI
description:
About Nomos

Europe pays more than twice as much for electricity as the US or Asia. To reach competitive price levels, Europe has to lean on solar and deliver the flexibility that makes this feasible. Nomos is building a full-stack power company to unlock that flexibility by connecting millions of homes to Europe’s energy markets.

At Nomos, we care about our craft and take full responsibility for what we build. We hire for spikes, not an absence of weaknesses, and look for exceptional ability backed by a record of achievement. This has brought together IMO and IOI medalists, former founders and Olympic athletes in a team whose individual strengths reinforce one another.

 

What you’ll do

We’re building an energy company from first principles. That means rethinking the operational work behind it: which processes we need, how they run, and what agents can take on. You’ll build the AI systems that let Nomos serve more customers without scaling manual work at the same rate.

  • Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand their workflows and find where AI can make the biggest difference.

  • Build agents and integrations that handle real operational work, from customer onboarding to communication with energy market participants.

  • Own what you ship: design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.

 

Exciting challenges

  • Rethink how an energy company operates. Building from scratch gives us the freedom to question processes that established suppliers take for granted. You’ll decide how software, agents, and people work together and turn that into systems the company depends on every day.

  • Put the newest AI capabilities to work in production. Nomos is built around AI. You’ll have access to new models and tools as they become available, with generous spending limits to experiment. The engineering challenge is making them dependable at scale: testing behaviour, handling exceptions, and knowing when a person needs to step in.

 

Who you are

  • You’ve shipped and operated production software. You understand how systems fit together, how they fail, and how to keep them working as usage grows.

  • You have hands-on experience building with AI. You can connect models to tools and data, evaluate their behaviour, and make sound decisions about where agents are useful.

  • You move quickly and care about the details. You turn an ambiguous problem into working software, test it properly, and stay responsible for it after launch.

 

References

Paul Burkhardt

 

Why join us?

As an early member of Nomos, you’ll help shape the company and share in its financial upside. Backed by Index Ventures, we’re building a European category leader in one of the world’s largest industries, making electricity affordable and Europe more competitive.

Building a power company from scratch brings complex, rewarding challenges and the chance to solve Europe’s energy crisis for the long term. You’ll learn from people with exceptional depth in their fields, challenge each other’s thinking and take responsibility from the start.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
About Vibe

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.


Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.


Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.


This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat.

What You'll Do

Payroll and contractors

  • Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation.

  • Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees.

  • Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies.

  • Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file.

  • Reconcile each cycle to catch what doesn't add up before it’s live.

People operations and HR admin

  • Manage employment documents for a team spread across France, the US, and remote.

  • Administer benefits: enrollments, changes, and the questions employees bring.

  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly.

Employee support

  • Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions.

  • Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs.

  • Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law.

Systems and projects

  • Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it.

  • Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts.

  • Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers.

  • Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved.

  • Experience with an HRIS.

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool.

  • Exposure to international or EOR payroll.

  • Comfort building automations to cut manual work.

  • Experience at a scale-up.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  • Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  • Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  • Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.
